node.statement: Approximate invariance: under the root hypotheses, for every b in B one has ||Delta b-Phi(Delta b)|| <= 2K*eta*||b||. Indeed Delta b-Phi Delta b = Delta(b-Upsilon Delta b)+(Delta Upsilon-Phi)(Delta b), whose two terms have norms at most K*eta*||b|| and K*eta*||Delta b||<=K*eta*||b|| by node 1.1.
